result:
I created `docs/policies/version-scheme.md`. It records semantic versioning (semver) as the current decision.

The record behind it is commit 7c9ae46, which set the version-scheme decision value to "semver". It also draws on the earlier session where the maintainer said "semver is cleaner". The file doesn't mention the calver scheme that semver replaced.

The record is filed under a name starting with `revoke-`, which could be read as semver being revoked. The other decision files use the same prefix, and their values are current choices, so I treated it as a naming convention.

I didn't commit the file.
